sources.title: Prompt engineering best practices for 2026 | Claude by Anthropic
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering is the craft of structuring instructions to get better outputs from AI models. It's how you phrase queries, specify style, provide context, and guide the model's behavior to achieve your goals. The difference between a vague instruction and a well-crafted prompt can mean the gap between generic outputs and exactly what you need.
